pat=re.compile(r'(C)(.)(H)(.{12,28}?)(C)(..)(H)')
rows=[]
for org,s in SEQ.items():
    m=pat.search(s)
    if not m:
        rows.append(dict(org=org,len=len(s),L1=None,L2=None,L3=None,L4=None,spacing=None,motif=None,complete=False)); continue
    c1=m.start(1)+1; h1=m.start(3)+1; c2=m.start(5)+1; h2=m.start(7)+1
    rows.append(dict(org=org, len=len(s), L1=f"C{c1}", L2=f"H{h1}", L3=f"C{c2}", L4=f"H{h2}",
                     spacing=c2-c1, motif=s[c1-1:c1+2]+"..."+s[c2-1:c2+3], complete=True))
L=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width",220); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",40); pd.set_option("display.max_rows",60)
print(L.to_string(index=False))
print("\nAll four Rieske ligands (CxH...CxxH) present:", int(L.complete.sum()), "/", len(L),
      f"= {100*L.complete.mean():.1f}%")
print("C1..C2 spacing: median", int(L.spacing.median()), "range", int(L.spacing.min()), "-", int(L.spacing.max()))

# ---- synteny co-occurrence summary from the NCBI neighbourhood scan ----
summary = pd.DataFrame({
 "category":["small Rieske gene present within +/-6 genes of fdeE",
             "small Rieske gene immediately adjacent to fdeE (+/-1..2)",
             "no small Rieske gene in the window"],
 "genomes":[58,57,7]})
tot=65
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax[0].barh(summary.category, summary.genomes, color=["#2f6f9f","#4e9ac9","#c05c4a"])
for i,v in enumerate(summary.genomes):
    ax[0].text(v+0.6, i, f"{v}/{tot} ({100*v/tot:.0f}%)", va="center", fontsize=10)
ax[0].set_xlim(0,80); ax[0].set_xlabel("number of genomes (n = 65 analysed)")
ax[0].set_title("fdeD-like Rieske gene co-occurs with fdeE-like\nflavin monooxygenase across 65 bacterial genomes", fontsize=11)
ax[0].invert_yaxis()

ax[1].bar(["all four\nligands present","one or more\nligand lost"],[int(L.complete.sum()), int((~L.complete).sum())],
          color=["#2f6f9f","#c05c4a"])
ax[1].set_ylabel("number of fdeD-adjacent Rieske proteins")
ax[1].set_title(f"Rieske cluster ligands CxH...CxxH in {len(L)} syntenic homologs", fontsize=11)
for i,v in enumerate([int(L.complete.sum()), int((~L.complete).sum())]):
    ax[1].text(i, v+0.4, str(v), ha="center")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
